summary: Turn AI proposals into governed pilots, clear ownership, and measurable adoption plans. Explore this five-day business leaders course.
lede: AI adoption for business leaders focuses on selecting viable use cases and moving them into governed pilots. Designed for business unit leaders, transformation leads, and technology sponsors, the course covers screening opportunities, setting pilot measures and stage gates, and assigning decision rights and human oversight. Participants also map workflow changes, assess risks, and prepare adoption roadmaps and executive updates grounded in operational evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who sponsor, assess, or implement AI adoption across business functions and need to make practical decisions about use cases, pilots, controls, and workforce change.
modules: AI Pilot Design with Model Cards
AI Risk Decisions with NIST AI RMF
AI Workflow Redesign and Human Oversight
AI Portfolio Reporting with OECD Principles
prerequisites: Expected background: experience sponsoring or managing business change, digital projects, or operational improvement. Coding is not required; exercises focus on business decisions, process artefacts, and spreadsheet-based pilot measures.
